context.transcript:
Hi, this is Monique.
I was your nurse during your visit to Dr. Balani's office earlier today.
I'm calling to let you know we've contacted the pharmacy near your home and placed the order for your new medication.
The pharmacist said the prescription will be ready at 1 o'clock, so you can get it then.
Also, our clinic would like your feedback.
You'll be mailed a patient satisfaction survey about the care provided to you today by our doctors, nurses, and receptionists.
We'd appreciate it if you'd fill out the survey and mail it back to us.
Thanks, and have a good day.
context.transcript_translation:
您好，我是 Monique。
我今天早些时候在您拜访 Balani 医生诊所时是您的护士。
我打电话来告诉您，我们已经联系了您家附近的药房，并为您的新药物下了订单。
药剂师说处方将在一点准备好，您可以那时取走。
另外，我们的诊所希望了解您的反馈。
关于今天由我们的医生、护士和接待人员为您提供的护理，您会收到一份患者满意度调查问卷通过邮件寄给您。
如果您能填写这份调查问卷并邮寄回来，我们将不胜感激。
谢谢，祝您有美好的一天。
